title: HUD performance (canvas draw calls) and post-review UI polish
common:
Project: /home/user/Raivon — «Raivon: Territory Wars», portrait mobile hex-territory strategy in Godot 4.5.1 (Mobile renderer). The owner wants a polished, friendly cartoon game (brief п.35–36, docs/art_direction.md §6, docs/ui_style.md) that runs on phones. The new UI (docs/ui_style.md, game/scripts/ui_kit.gd) looks right but is expensive: the 2D canvas alone costs 643–800 draw calls per frame (measured 2026-10-11 with tools/godot_shot.sh: default 769, --tab=buildings 643, --demo=battle:20 688, '--zoom=0.45 --dl=8 --ai-dl=8' 800), on top of 243–262 draws of the 3D map (visible + shadow). The frame budget is ~565 draws total (docs/art_direction.md §6.12: ≤ +10 % of v12's 375–514). So the canvas must come down to ≤ 300 draws on every standard screen (stretch: ≤ 250) WITHOUT visible change to the design.
Rules:
- Other agents work in this repo at the same time; each step lists the files it owns. Edit only those; re-read a file right before editing it; never revert changes you did not make. main.gd is shared: keep to the call sites your step names.
- NEVER run git commit/add/push/checkout/stash/reset (diff/status/log are fine). The main session commits.
- Godot: /opt/godot/Godot_v4.5.1-stable_linux.x86_64. Before '--headless --path game --import' check that no other import runs (pgrep -fa -- '--import' shows nothing but your grep), else wait and retry.
- Screenshots: tools/godot_shot.sh OUT.png [--demo=..] [--tab=..] [--select=q,r] [--dl=N] [--zoom=Z] --lang=ru --shot-delay=3. It prints a 'perf ... draws_3d= draws_shadow= draws_canvas=' line. Read every PNG you make (they are images) and judge honestly.
- Tests: '$G --headless --path game --script res://tests/test_flow.gd' must keep 224 PASS lines and no 'SCRIPT ERROR'; run test_march / other suites in game/tests/ when you touch their logic. python3 tools/ui_lint.py --strict and python3 tools/check_strings.py must stay clean.
- Scratch files go under /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Raivon/6fa81df3-3b92-5348-855c-cb135734d3b5/scratchpad/perf/<step id>/ .

steps.title: Profile canvas draws per HUD subtree; batch the always-visible HUD
owner_files: game/scripts/main.gd (perf probe and HUD wiring only)
steps.instructions:
1. Baseline. Shoot the standard set BEFORE changing anything and keep it: default, --tab=buildings, --tab=development, --tab=diplomacy, --tab=world, --select=0,3 --focus=0,3,0.06, --demo=battle:20, '--zoom=0.45 --dl=8 --ai-dl=8'. Record draws_canvas of each.
2. Probe. Add a debug probe (e.g. a '--perf-tree' user arg handled in main.gd's _shot, printed by godot_shot.sh) that, for the shot frame, walks the HUD CanvasLayers and their top-level children (then one level deeper for the worst ones), hides each subtree for a frame, and prints the canvas draw delta per subtree (Viewport.get_render_info(RENDER_INFO_TYPE_CANVAS, RENDER_INFO_DRAW_CALLS_IN_FRAME)). Also count SubViewports (minimap, portraits, card art) and their own draws. Write the breakdown table to the scratch dir and into your report.
3. Understand why. Godot 4.5's RD canvas renderer batches consecutive rect-type commands (textured rects, glyphs) that share texture, material, blend and clip; it breaks a batch on every texture/material switch, every polygon/triangle-array command (StyleBoxFlat with rounded corners/borders/shadow is a triangle array), every custom ShaderMaterial, clip_contents/clip_children, CanvasGroup, and interleaving of different textures (icon → font atlas → icon). Text outline and fill may sit on different font texture pages. Verify these assumptions with small measurements instead of trusting them.
4. Fix the biggest costs, keeping the look pixel-identical (allow only antialiasing noise): typical tools — (a) draw nothing invisible: nodes under opaque modals, alpha-0 or fully clipped/off-screen nodes, empty decor; (b) bake static decoration into textures: a Kit-level cache that renders a component's static layers (rounded face, outline, lip, gloss, shadow) once to an ImageTexture / nine-patch from ONE shared atlas so many panels become batched rects (StyleBoxTexture/NinePatchRect or draw_texture_rect_region); (c) group same-texture draws (all icons from one atlas, glyphs in a row) by ordering siblings so the font atlas is not interleaved with icons; (d) replace per-node ShaderMaterials on static items with baked textures; (e) a static subtree that rarely changes (top bar frame, folder tabs, tray background, minimap frame) may be cached through a SubViewport with UPDATE_ONCE redrawn only on change — only for non-interactive decoration, input must keep working. Prefer fixes inside ui_kit.gd components (every screen benefits) over per-screen hacks.
5. Target for this step: the always-visible HUD — top bar (pills, portrait, left column, minimap), folder tabs and card tray, hex panel and big action button. Default screen draws_canvas ≤ 300, tab screens ≤ 300, --select ≤ 320.
6. Parity: after-shots of the whole standard set must match the baseline. Write a small diff helper (python3 + PIL, HUD regions; the 3D map may differ slightly from animation phase) and look at the diff images; any visible change is a bug.
steps.verify: Table before → after of draws_canvas for every standard shot; probe breakdown before/after; diff images of the HUD; test_flow 224 PASS; ui_lint strict clean; check_strings clean; touch input still works (test_flow covers taps; also spot-check a button press path in code if you cached anything).

steps.title: Batch modals, war screens, shop and meta screens
steps.instructions: Continue H1 (read the H1 result in the resume file or the git log/diff if referenced; reuse its probe, its cache and its diff helper). Measure every remaining screen with the probe: --demo=battle:20 (battle hand), the battle result, peace treaty, ultimatum, shop (all its tabs), war pass, chronicle, settings, commanders, commander card, calendar, profile, inbox, generic info/choice dialogs, market, swap, FTUE coach, toasts (find the demo/args in tools/godot_shot.sh and main.gd's demo handler; docs/dev/how_to_run.md lists them). Target: every screen ≤ 300 canvas draws while open (≤ 350 for the shop grid and the commanders album if impossible otherwise — explain). The HUD under an opaque full-screen modal must not draw. Also make sure the 3D world view is not rendered under fully opaque full-screen modals if that is cheap and safe (pause or hide the 3D camera/world only while such a modal is open — measure the total draw_calls). Keep pixel parity (diff helper) and input.
steps.verify: Table before → after for every screen above (canvas and total draw calls); diff images; test_flow 224 PASS; ui_lint strict; check_strings.

steps.title: In-world label polish from the s13/s14 reviews
steps.instructions:
Low-priority defects found by the s13 and s14 reviewers (docs/ui_style.md §4.14 is the spec):
- Army plates: the stacked plate's health bar overlaps the lower tip of the hex; chips/plates are not clamped inside the screen (see --demo=swap --shot-delay=12); the pixel scale px_k is fixed at creation — recompute on viewport size change (get_viewport().size_changed); the strike chip is always red — colour it by the attacker's team; ARMY_LOOK duplicates palette literals — take them from SoftPalette / Kit tokens.
- Floaters (+N numbers): pale Color literals → palette tokens with enough contrast on the sunny lawn; they clip at the right screen edge — clamp 24 px inside; overlapping floaters are not decluttered — route them through the existing MapTag/_declutter.
Do not change territory shaders or models.
steps.verify: Screenshots before/after: default, --demo=battle:20, --demo=march, --demo=swap --shot-delay=12, --demo=dip2 --shot-delay=12, a narrow window (--res if supported) for the resize case; test_flow and test_march PASS.

steps.title: Text polish: phrase-wall toasts, EN guillemets, lint loophole
steps.instructions:
- Toasts that glue several facts with «·» into a wall of text: toast.collected, army_info, hex_info, colonized, march.started, armies_marching, repair_started (find them in the strings file and their call sites). Per docs/ui_style.md (toasts: one short line, icon carries the subject): rewrite each as one short sentence or a pill with at most two parts; move secondary facts to the hex panel/chips where they already exist, or drop them. Keep ru and en (and any other languages present) in sync.
- EN strings must not use Russian guillemets « » (cmdr.album.*, cmdr.bio.*, the chronicle/calendar title, any other EN cell): use “ ” or none. Add a check to tools/check_strings.py so it never comes back.
- tools/ui_lint.py rule R4 (pictographs/emoji) can be bypassed with escape sequences (\u2694, char(0x2694), String.chr …) — close the loophole and fix any hits it then finds (strings or code) without changing what players see except removing glyph icons.
steps.verify: check_strings clean (with the new rule), ui_lint --strict clean, test_flow 224 PASS; screenshots of a few toasts ru/en (main.gd has a toast demo, see s12).

steps.title: Game UI polish from the s14 review, final measurement and docs
steps.instructions:
- An empty slate tray shows behind the post-battle windows (result / peace / ultimatum): hide the tray (or the whole bottom HUD) while those modals are open.
- Capital selected: the big button shows a green «Улучшить» without a price although the upgrade is locked — it must use the locked role (grey with lock icon) and show the reason (e.g. the required level/age) per docs/ui_style.md button roles; check other locked actions for the same bug.
- The research '+N' overflow chip (more research than fits) reads like a bonus — restyle as a neutral count chip (slate, '+N', no green) per §4 chips.
- Final measurement: run the standard set and every screen from H2, write the table (3D visible / shadow / canvas / total) into docs/art_direction.md §6.12 (the Draw calls row and its note) and a short 'Performance' note in docs/ui_style.md describing the rules the H1/H2 work established (how components stay batched, what not to do).
steps.verify: Screenshots: --demo=battle:20 result/peace/ultimatum windows, capital selected (find its coords; --select), research tab; test_flow 224 PASS; ui_lint strict; check_strings; the final table.
